name: Pin
tagline: End-to-end AI recruiting agent that sources, screens, and schedules.
description: Pin is an AI recruiting platform that runs the top of the hiring funnel autonomously. Its agent searches across 850M+ candidate profiles, matches them to a role with skills-based ranking, runs multi-channel outreach sequences, and books interviews — then syncs everything to your ATS via 120+ integrations. It targets recruiters and founders who want sourcing-through-scheduling handled without stitching point tools together.
insight: New York startup; launched out of stealth in Dec 2024 with a $3M seed led by Expa Ventures.
edge: Bundles sourcing, screening, outreach, and scheduling into one agent over 850M+ profiles and 120+ ATS integrations, rather than a single-step tool.

references.title: Pin thinks AI can fix recruitment's biggest problems
